---docker-compose.yml---
#Start dependency services by using:
#$ docker-compose up -d

# This file is only used for development environment (or local tests).
# For CI see .gitlab-ci.yml

version: '2'

services:

  apache-tika:
    image: apache/tika:3.2.3.0-full
    restart: 'no'
    ports:
      - '9998:9998'

  mailpit:
    # https://hub.docker.com/r/axllent/mailpit/tags?page=1&ordering=last_updated
    image: axllent/mailpit:latest
    restart: 'no'
    environment:
      MP_SMTP_AUTH_ACCEPT_ANY: "true"
      MP_SMTP_AUTH_ALLOW_INSECURE: "true"
    ports:
      - '1025:1025'
      # mails can be read in browser on http://localhost:8025
      - '8025:8025'

  # This allows to locally run rails test:system against the same browser as used on CI (see .gitlab-ci.yml for details and check for changes).
  # SELENIUM_URL=http://localhost:4444/wd/hub/ CI=true rails test:system
#  selenium-chrome:
#    image: selenium/standalone-chrome:4
#    restart: 'no'
#    environment:
#      - SE_VNC_NO_PASSWORD=1
#      - SE_NODE_OVERRIDE_MAX_SESSIONS=true
#      - SE_NODE_MAX_SESSIONS=2
#      - TZ=Europe/Berlin
#    shm_size: '2gb'
#    ports:
#      - '4444:4444'

# To run local tests against specific postgres version comment out below and use 
# DATABASE_URL=postgresql://postgres:postgres@localhost:5433/samarbeid_test rails test
#  postgres:
#    image: postgres:18
#    restart: no
#    environment:
#      POSTGRES_HOST_AUTH_METHOD: trust
#    ports:
#      - '5433:5432'
---Procfile.dev---
web: bin/rails s
vite: bin/vite dev
---.ruby-version---
ruby-3.4.10
---.tool-versions---
nodejs 24.9.0
yarn 4.13.0
